question: Which 5 suburbs had the most house sales in the last 12 months?
expectation: The five suburbs with the highest count of house sales (sum of n_sold, property_type = house) over the 12 months ending at the latest month in the sales mart (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-01), ranked. Dubbo, Orange, Port Macquarie, Austral, Armidale as at 2026-06-01.
golden_sql:
SELECT suburb, sum(n_sold) AS n_sold
FROM marts.property_sales
WHERE property_type = 'house'
  AND month >= (SELECT max(month) FROM marts.property_sales) - interval '11 months'
GROUP BY suburb
ORDER BY n_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
golden_sandbox:
ranked = df.sort_values("n_sold", ascending=False).head(5)
result = skills.build_report(
    summary="Dubbo led NSW house sales over the last 12 months, followed by Orange and Port Macquarie.",

        {"label": "Top suburb", "value": str(ranked.iloc[0]["suburb"]), "basis": f"{int(ranked.iloc[0]['n_sold'])} houses sold"},
    ],
    main_chart=skills.comparison_chart(ranked, label_col="suburb", value_col="n_sold", title="House sales, last 12 months"),
)
golden_answer:
Over the 12 months to June 2026 the suburbs with the most house sales were Dubbo
(999), Orange (874), Port Macquarie (691), Austral (593) and Armidale (586). The
top of the list is regional: Dubbo and Orange alone account for more house
sales than any Sydney suburb, with Austral the only metropolitan entry, driven
by new-estate completions.
